title: Dream Spell Core
text: Rarely found in the loot Crystal Ball of a Radiant Courtyard or the sealed archive of a Shadow Library.
Equipping grants 400 maximum mana, 20% spell power, 30% mana regeneration and 10 cost reduction. In a Mana Engine, its base output is 1024 su and 1024 FE/s before grid multipliers.
{dream}It seems to resonate with your mana...
